outcome: Faecal incontinence severity (Cleveland Clinic faecal incontinence severity scores)
cohort: 211 women (including those with OASIS, those who underwent elective caesarean, and primigravid women)
finding: While OASIS alone has a limited effect on fecal incontinence, the presence of IBS significantly worsens fecal incontinence in women with OASIS.
mod_finding: Women with both OASIS and IBS had the most severe faecal incontinence scores.
